svg.title: Schottky diode
svg.desc: Schottky diode, Schottky barrier diode: §8.5.1 diode with S-hooked cathode bar (industry practice; not in the 1975 edition). Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (anode) (24,8), end (cathode) (24,68).
